# craft forward packed-forward with gzip option and minimal invalid gzip body

def fixstr(s):
    b=s.encode(); n=len(b)
    assert n<32
    return bytes([0xa0|n])+b

def fixarray(items): return bytes([0x90|len(items)])+b''.join(items)
def fixmap(items): return bytes([0x80|len(items)])+b''.join(k+v for k,v in items)

tag=fixstr('t')
options=fixmap([(fixstr('compressed'), fixstr('gzip'))])
# invalid gzip: header only 18 bytes minimum, but body too short / malformed
payload=b'\x1f\x8b\x08\x00' + b'\x00'*14
obj=fixarray([tag, payload, options])
open('/workspace/poc2.bin','wb').write(obj)
print(len(obj), obj.hex())
